description: This file defines the ReportsController class for a Spring Boot REST API, providing endpoints for generating various reports such as customer bills, monthly summaries, and revenue summaries.

classes.name: ReportsController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller exposing endpoints for generating various reports related to customer bills, monthly summaries, and revenue.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Handles GET requests for customer-specific bill reports, returning a CustomerBillReportDto.

methods.name: monthly
methods.description: Handles GET requests for monthly summaries, taking year and month as parameters, returning a MonthlyReportDto.

methods.name: revenue
methods.description: Handles GET requests for revenue summaries, returning a RevenueSummaryDto.
